newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CSOB lowers base 1-yr lending rate to 22 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech CSOB lowers base 1-yr lending rate to 22 pct.

text.p: Czech Ceskoslovenska Obchodni Banka a.s. on Thursday said it was lowering its base one-year lending rate by three percentage points to 22 percent, effective immediately.
A CSOB statement added that the bank's prime lending rate would also fall by the same amount to 20 percent.

According to the statement, the price of credits for between one and two years will drop four percentage points to 19 percent, while credits from two to three years will ease two percentage points to 17 percent.
